purpose: Bounded end-to-end investigation of ancestor revocation, receipt-or-expiry closure and recovery-safe replay admission
physical_execution: One localhost host; one sequential client process and one asyncio server process with five sockets and five SQLite databases

post_inspection_differential_audit.purpose: Check Store decisions against the separately implemented verifier and exercise a floor-dominated durable-receipt recovery branch

delegation_actor_boundary.purpose: Bind child issuance to an explicit acting principal without claiming production caller authentication

record_and_reply_envelope.purpose: Close parser/transport bounds for the admitted record cap; not a production protocol-size claim

hidden_descendant_closure_case.purpose: Exercise the theorem-facing hidden-lineage path after a mixed receipt/expiry closure

reproduction_source_closure.purpose: Prevent a segmented reproduction from combining outputs produced by different source trees

receipt_authentication_boundary.purpose: Check that only the exact gateway-domain receipt can cover a certificate coordinate; not a production credential claim

stateful_replay_audit.purpose: Exercise evolving durable state, compaction and recovery beyond isolated request fixtures
stateful_replay_audit.boundary: Deterministic bounded owned inputs; not a mechanized proof, independent implementation, or deployment trace

batch_transaction_atomicity.fixture: A two-event batch whose first revoke is admissible and whose second grant exceeds the 20,000-record cap
batch_transaction_atomicity.expected: The RPC fails without a receipt, no durable or volatile revoke leaks, and the original authority remains usable
batch_transaction_atomicity.purpose: Check whole-batch rollback, including the intentionally volatile negative-control state

local_delegate_revoke_serialization.transport: Two concurrent owned loopback RPCs to the same gateway and SQLite connection
local_delegate_revoke_serialization.postcondition: After both replies, no issued child is usable and the root is revoked
local_delegate_revoke_serialization.boundary: Single event loop, one process, one connection; not a distributed linearizability proof

crash_storage_integrity.check: PRAGMA integrity_check after modeled process recovery
crash_storage_integrity.boundary: Process termination only; no machine power cut, filesystem corruption, or disk-loss claim

recovery_compaction_window.purpose: Execute the long-downtime window that invalidates the Delta specialization without weakening authorization safety
recovery_compaction_window.boundary: Metadata-retention scope check; not a core closure counterexample or a process-crash claim
